div.div: The Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture. Left: We train conditional latent DiT models. The input latent is decomposed into patches and processed by several DiT blocks. Right: Details of our DiT blocks. We experiment with variants of standard transformer blocks that incorporate conditioning via adaptive layer norm, cross-attention and extra input tokens. Adaptive layer norm works best.
